GracePrinciples.Principle: Contract first: define the change, affected modules, immutable baseline, target assertions and write scope before observed writes.
Branch first: significant work starts from the exact verified main SHA and reaches main only through a pull request.
Fail closed: missing spec, stale scope, failed migration, failed verification, pending check or changed PR head blocks merge.
One source of truth: calendar, search, reporting and notification surfaces are projections of authoritative domain records.
Evidence over inference: extracted facts, automated matches and migrations retain deterministic evidence and provenance.
Append-only schema evolution: a migration that reached main is immutable; later changes use a new sequential migration.
Recoverability is part of correctness: schema changes prove clean install, upgrade, integrity, pre-migration backup and restoration.
Specialist Codex roles refine GRACE tasks but never bypass the GRACE lifecycle or CI gates.
